text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(—A heat is swirling.
A fiery passion honed just for this day—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(Clashing together and making sparks fly!
Hot, hot, so hot—this is awesome!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahaha, ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what an unexpected turn of events! You really
never know what's gonna happen in a race!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Still, I ended up watching C.B., didn't I?
Maybe running one more time is what makes C.B. who she is.

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think so too.
I can definitely take the Kikuka Sho!
The dream of being the strongest in history isn't over yet!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
No, no, she lost today.
Besides, the greatest of all time is that girl called a legend.
After all, she's a five-time G1 winner.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"CB is strong and all, but the fact is,
she didn't win."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: No way, CB is seriously gonna blow right past them!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Even if we lost today, it starts now!
She's an Umamusume who can win 5... no, even 6 GⅠ races!

Mr. C.B. fell
just one step short at the Japan Derby.

And yet that day, for some reason,
she walked home with a bouncy, dance-like spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm frustrated about losing.
Truly... But—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! It was fun.
It was heated—there couldn't have been a better stage...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear Ace's voice?
I was so thrilled—it felt like a true roar of victory.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is next, huh?
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, hey! It's Rudolf!
Following her gaze, I saw Symboli Rudolf running on the TV of an electronics store.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Feature on Promising Newcomer Umamusume!", huh...
As expected of Rudolf! You're already drawing so much attention.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...She's finally making her appearance too.
I wonder how much she's transformed over this past year."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Heheh! The Twinkle Series is just full of exciting things...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Dammit allllll!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *wheeze*, *gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...I couldn't win.
On top of that, everyone's eyes were stolen away by CB――"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'll become an 'ace' that defies all common sense", huh.
"I'll show them all", huh...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm nothing more than a stepping stone—!

—Once summer passes and autumn arrives, it'll be the Kikuka Sho.
The final race of the Classic Triple Crown,
and the third major showdown against Katsuragi Ace.
